keep: Golovach J_I dynamic graph and clause occurrence incidence
initial seed/source scaffold and exact 111/Q ancestry

frozen_core.allow_only: Edges among X0 anchors of different fixed colors.

test_space.legal_internal_edges: Any subset of the six cross-color pairs; with one anchor per color every such edge is proper under the fixed precoloring.
test_space.primary_test: Complete K4 closure on the four anchors.
test_space.strengthened_control: Exhaust all 2^6=64 legal internal anchor-edge sets on the frozen one-clause role instance.

stop_rule: Stop at first failed ordered check for each anchor-edge choice. Do not add any non-X0-internal chord after failure.

terminals.PASS_SOURCE_VALID_HARD_CORE: Some legal X0-internal edge set makes all seven checks pass.
terminals.FAIL_WITH_NEW_MINIMAL_P7: Every legal X0-internal edge set still fails P7; record an anchor-internal-edge-independent induced P7 when available.
terminals.FAIL_SOURCE_LEGALITY: Some required X0-internal repair edge violates the earliest exact source/precoloring obligation.

target_claim_ceiling: This gate tests only semantics-neutral X0-X0 chord repair of the frozen inverse.
Failure does not rule out other source-valid hardness embeddings.
Success would still require arbitrary-N source/P7 proof and exact NAE reconstruction before hardness localization.
